home.title: Gargaarsa qabatamaa amanamaa taʼe argadhu
home.eyebrow: Odeeffannoo uummataa fi meeshaalee waloo Calais
home.description: Gargaarsi maal, eessatti fi yoom akka argamu ilaali. Sochiin maxxanfame hundi dhaabbata itti gaafatamaa fi odeeffannoon yoom akka mirkanaaʼe agarsiisa.
home.trustBody: Duudhaaleen shan odeeffannoon akkamitti akka maxxanfamu, bira gaʼamuu fi eegamu, dhaabbileen immoo akkamitti waliin hojjetan murteessu.
home.valueDignityBody: Herrega malee fi gargaarsa ati ilaaltu ykn argattu galmeessu malee odeeffannoo uummataa dubbisi.
home.valueReliabilityBody: Eenyu itti gaafatamaa akka taʼe, odeeffannoon yoom akka mirkanaaʼe fi deemuu kee dura yoom gaafachuu akka qabdu ilaali.
home.valueAccessibilityBody: Meeshaalee, saffisa qunnamtii, afaanota, kallattii barruu fi sadarkaa dubbisuu adda addaa irratti odeeffannoo ifaa fayyadami.
home.valueCollaborationBody: Dhaabbileef maxxansuu, taateewwan qindeessuu fi hojii irra deddeebiʼamu hirʼisuuf iddoo waloo kenni.
home.valueResponsibilityBody: Odeeffannoo maxxanfame, sirreeffama fi hayyama hundaaf nama itti gaafatamaa fi seenaa kaaʼi.
home.metaDescription: Calais keessatti odeeffannoo qabatamaa ilaalame argadhu, yoom akka mirkanaaʼe ilaali, dhaabbata itti gaafatamaa adda baasi.
